text_en: Then Joseph threw himself on his father’s face and wept over him and kissed him.
text_cn: 若瑟伏在他父亲的脸上，痛哭亲吻，

text_en: Joseph commanded the physicians in his service to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel;
text_cn: 然后吩咐照料自己的医生，用香料包殓他父亲；医生便用香料包殓了以色列。

text_en: they spent forty days in doing this, for that is the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians wept for him seventy days.
text_cn: 为他共费了四十天，因为用香料包殓尸体原需要这些天数。埃及人为他举哀七十天。

text_en: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph addressed the household of Pharaoh, “If now I have found favor with you, please speak to Pharaoh as follows:
text_cn: 举哀期一过，若瑟就向法郎的朝廷说：“我如在你们眼中得宠，请你们代我转告法郎说：

text_en: My father made me swear an oath; he said, ‘I am about to die. In the tomb that I hewed out for myself in the land of Canaan, there you shall bury me. ’ Now therefore let me go up, so that I may bury my father; then I will return. ”
text_cn: 我父亲曾叫我起誓，对我说：看，我快要死了！我在客纳罕地，曾为自己凿了一个坟墓，你应把我葬在那里。现在请让我上去埋葬我父亲，然后回来。”

text_en: Pharaoh answered, “Go up, and bury your father, as he made you swear to do. ”
text_cn: 法郎回复说：“你就照你父亲令你起的誓，上去埋葬他吧！”

text_en: So Joseph went up to bury his father. With him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his household, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
text_cn: 于是若瑟上去埋葬他父亲，与他一同去的，有法郎的一切臣仆，朝廷的显要，和埃及国所有的绅士；

text_en: as well as all the household of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children, their flocks, and their herds were left in the land of Goshen.
text_cn: 还有若瑟全家和他的兄弟们，并他父亲的家属，只留下家中幼小，羊群和家畜在哥笙地。

text_en: Both chariots and charioteers went up with him. It was a very great company.
text_cn: 与他同去的，尚有车辆和骑兵：实在是一大队行列。

text_en: When they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, they held there a very great and sorrowful lamentation; and he observed a time of mourning for his father seven days.
text_cn: 当他们到了约但河对岸的阿塔得打禾场，就在那里举行了极备哀荣的隆重丧礼；若瑟又为自己的父亲举哀了七天。

text_en: When the Canaanite inhabitants of the land saw the mourning on the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning on the part of the Egyptians. ” Therefore the place was named Abel-mizraim; it is beyond the Jordan.
text_cn: 住在当地的客纳罕人见了阿塔得打禾场上的丧礼，就说：“这为埃及人实是一场极备哀荣的丧礼。”因而给那在约但对岸的地方，起名叫阿贝耳米兹辣殷。

text_en: Thus his sons did for him as he had instructed them.
text_cn: 雅各伯的儿子们完全照他们的父亲所吩咐的给他办了：

text_en: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field at Machpelah, the field near Mamre, which Abraham bought as a burial site from Ephron the Hittite.
text_cn: 将他运到客纳罕地，葬在面对玛默勒的玛革培拉田里的山洞内；这块田是亚巴郎由赫特人厄斐龙买了来作为私有坟地。

text_en: After he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone up with him to bury his father.
text_cn: 若瑟葬了父亲以后，遂和他兄弟们，以及所有与他上来埋葬他父亲的人们，返回了埃及。

text_en: Realizing that their father was dead, Joseph’s brothers said, “What if Joseph still bears a grudge against us and pays us back in full for all the wrong that we did to him? ”
text_cn: 若瑟的兄弟们见父亲已死，就说：“或者若瑟仍怀恨我们，要报复我们对他所行的一切恶事。”

text_en: So they approached Joseph, saying, “Your father gave this instruction before he died,
text_cn: 因此便派人去见若瑟说：“你父亲未死以前曾嘱咐说：

text_en: ‘Say to Joseph: I beg you, forgive the crime of your brothers and the wrong they did in harming you. ’ Now therefore please forgive the crime of the servants of the God of your father. ” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
text_cn: 你们要这样对若瑟说：请你务必饶恕你兄弟们的过失和罪恶，因为他们实在虐待了你。现在，求你饶恕你父亲的天主的仆人们的过失吧！”若瑟听他们对他说出这样的话，就哭了起来。

text_en: Then his brothers also wept, fell down before him, and said, “We are here as your slaves. ”
text_cn: 后来他的兄弟们还亲自来，俯伏在他面前说：“看，我们都是你的奴隶！”

text_en: But Joseph said to them, “Do not be afraid! Am I in the place of God?
text_cn: 若瑟对他们说：“不要害怕！我岂能替代天主？

text_en: Even though you intended to do harm to me, God intended it for good, in order to preserve a numerous people, as he is doing today.
text_cn: 你们原有意对我作的恶事，天主却有意使之变成好事，造成了今日的结果：挽救了许多人民的性命。

text_en: So have no fear; I myself will provide for you and your little ones. ” In this way he reassured them, speaking kindly to them.
text_cn: 所以，你们不必害怕，有我维持你们和你们的孩子。”他这样抚慰他们，使他们安心。

text_en: So Joseph remained in Egypt, he and his father’s household; and Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
text_cn: 若瑟和他父亲的家属，以后就住在埃及。若瑟活到了一百一十岁，

text_en: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation; the children of Machir son of Manasseh were also born on Joseph’s knees.
text_cn: 见到了厄弗辣因的第三代子孙；默纳协的儿子玛基尔的儿子们，也都生在若瑟的膝下。

text_en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die; but God will surely come to you, and bring you up out of this land to the land that he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. ”
text_cn: 若瑟对自己的兄弟们说：“我快要死了；但天主要看顾你们，领你们由这地回到他誓许给亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的地方去。”

text_en: So Joseph made the Israelites swear, saying, “When God comes to you, you shall carry up my bones from here. ”
text_cn: 若瑟又叫以色列的儿子们起誓说：“当天主看顾你们时，你们应将我的骨骸由这里带回去。”

text_en: And Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old; he was embalmed and placed in a coffin in Egypt.
text_cn: 若瑟死了，享寿一百一十岁。人遂用香料包殓了他，放在棺椁内，安厝（cuò）在埃及。
